notes: The OG Widget no longer starts partly above the top of the screen. Its default startup position was off-screen until you snapped it somewhere, which then stuck.

Cause: a size left over from when the widget could be dragged to any size. That old size is still in the settings file — 480 by 1920 — and 1920 of those pixels is taller than the screen once display scaling is applied, so the window was…

The widget is fixed-width with a content-driven height, so a remembered size is meaningless for it. Both dimensions are now ignored on startup and the stale numbers are cleared out of the settings file the first time this version runs, so…
The previous release fixed the width this way but still trusted the remembered height, which is the half that was causing this.
